title: ASI Kedro
summary: An end-to-end MLOps project (Kedro pipelines, AutoGluon AutoML, FastAPI serving, Streamlit dashboard) built for a university course to classify airline passenger satisfaction from a Kaggle dataset. A dedicated synthetic-data pipeline node and the Streamlit app both fit SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on the preprocessed data and call SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic to score the generated records.
